entities.summary:
Euphranor of Corinth was a Greek artist who excelled both as a sculptor and as a painter. Born in the 5th century BCE, Euphranor is considered one of the most renowned artists of the Classical period.

He was known for his expertise in various mediums, including bronze casting and fresco painting, with works attributed to him found in prominent museums across Greece and Rome.

Euphranor's artistic influence can be seen in the development of Hellenistic sculpture and the spread of Greek art throughout the Mediterranean region during the 4th century BCE.

The exact dates of his life are unknown, but his legacy continued to inspire artists for centuries, with Euphranor's style remaining a benchmark for excellence in ancient Greek art.

In the words of the Roman historian Pliny the Elder, 'Euphranor was one of the most celebrated sculptors of his time,' demonstrating the enduring impact of this artist on the world of classical art.
